models.provider: Basic: FFmpeg. Full AI: Higgsfield. Analysis/script: selected OpenAI or Claude independently.

models.cost: Full mode records provider usage and does not require a guessed upfront reservation. Legacy mixed mode retains its separate configured price/limit behavior. Neither is a verified invoice.
models.approval: Generation, scene relation review, composition and publication remain separate.
models.unknown: No automatic replay or provider fallback.
not_verified: Real account availability, current quota, paid success and actual invoice.

models.provider: Claude for stored copy/image plan; OpenAI for image generation. Basic local composition makes zero image API calls.
models.selection: No selectable image model, aspect ratio or image-reference generation adapter. All generation/storage routes require a news article.
models.snapshot: Saved model, style, source/FullImagePlan, request hash, approval time, one-shot claim and file hash. Exact composed prompt/size/quality/output-format are not separately versioned.
models.cost: Reported usage only; null usage is unknown, not zero cost. provider_invoice_not_verified is retained.
models.approval: Copy/plan generation, image generation and human image review are separate.
models.unknown: Failed and unknown one-shot claims cannot auto-replay. No silent fallback.
not_verified: Real account/model availability, paid generation success and actual invoice.

models.provider: Claude script and Higgsfield Seedance reference-to-video; no automatic provider switch.
models.selection: Fixed 720p, 9:16, 4–10 second clips and generate_audio=false. Claude model frozen when job is created.
models.snapshot: Character configuration, script/prompts, reference SHA-256, model, Claude model, episode/day limits and quote hash are frozen. Plan changes fail validation.
models.cost: Official provider estimates are separate from reported_billed_usd, which remains null unless actually reported. Unknown submissions retain approved quote exposure.
models.approval: Script, reference upload/quote, scene submission, any authorized retry and final composition are separately gated.
models.unknown: Ambiguous scene submission stops further submissions and cannot silently replay.
not_implemented: Using the news-video model selector as a character model selector
not_verified: Real Seedance account contract, model availability, quotation and generated result.

minimal_followup_plan.detail: 뉴스 분석 모델, 뉴스 영상 모델, 이미지 고정 모델, 캐릭터 고정 모델을 구분한다. 지원되지 않는 모델·비율·reference 선택을 지원 완료로 표시하지 않는다.
향후 승인을 받은 경우에만 exact prompt와 size/quality/format 및 template version을 작업별 저장한다. 기존 결과 및 claim을 유지하고 재생성은 별도 실행으로 취급한다.
다중 모델을 추가하려면 read()의 현재 MODEL 일치 제한과 모델별 계약 dispatch를 먼저 설계한다. 현재 단계에서는 고정 모델 계약을 유지한다.
캐릭터 기본 인증은 HF_KEY 환경변수이며 뉴스 영상의 DPAPI 키 설정과 같다고 주장하지 않는다. 사용자별 배포 통합은 별도 승인한다.
공식 문서/코드 계약과 실제 계정 사용 가능성은 구분한다. 별도 승인된 테스트 키·호출 수·비용 한도가 확정될 때만 실호출한다.
